second_upper_molar_left.summary: Dental reference for the parotid duct opening.

landmarks.name: Parotid papilla
landmarks.description: The parotid duct opens on the inner cheek opposite this tooth, in the oral vestibule. The opening is in mucosa, not in the tooth.

second_upper_molar_left.modelNote: BodyParts3D 4.3 source surface, using the existing skull registration. Ducts and mucosal openings are illustrated separately.

submandibular_gland_left.summary: Paired glands beneath the mandible; a deep portion extends around the posterior free border of mylohyoid.

landmarks.name: Wharton duct
landmarks.description: Travels forward in the floor of the mouth, medial to the sublingual gland.

landmarks.name: Sublingual caruncle
landmarks.description: The duct opens on a small papilla on each side of the base of the lingual frenulum.

landmarks.name: Lingual nerve relationship
landmarks.description: The lingual nerve loops below the duct as it passes from its lateral to medial side.

submandibular_gland_left.modelNote: BodyParts3D 4.3 source surface, using the existing skull registration. Ducts and mucosal openings are illustrated separately.

sublingual_gland_right.summary: Paired glands beneath the oral mucosa, above mylohyoid, forming the sublingual folds.

landmarks.name: Ducts of Rivinus — sublingual fold
landmarks.description: Multiple small ducts empty along the crest of the sublingual fold on either side of the tongue.

landmarks.name: Bartholin duct — variable
landmarks.description: A major duct may join Wharton duct or open separately near the sublingual caruncle. A single shared opening is not universal.

landmarks.name: Lingual frenulum
landmarks.description: The midline mucosal fold under the tongue separates the two sides. The caruncles lie beside its base; the sublingual folds extend laterally and posteriorly.

parotid_gland_left.summary: Paired salivary glands beside the mandibular ramus, in front of and below the ear.

landmarks.name: Stensen duct
landmarks.description: Runs forward across masseter, turns medially at its anterior edge, then pierces buccinator.

landmarks.name: Parotid papilla — upper second molar
landmarks.description: Opens into the oral vestibule on the inner cheek opposite the upper second molar. The two tooth meshes show the dental reference, not the duct opening itself.

landmarks.name: Facial nerve relationship
landmarks.description: The facial nerve passes through the gland; it supplies facial expression muscles rather than the gland’s secretion.

parotid_gland_left.modelNote: SPL atlas surface from another specimen. Approximate alignment using the mandible; gland position has not been independently validated.
